title: On Quantum Mechanics and General Relativity
author: Logan Voss
scope: Current conditional quantum-state/geometry and reduced-gravity research bundle only.
novelty_status: Worldwide novelty and priority are not established by the bounded literature comparison. Known Gaussian geometry, dimensional reduction and integrability precedents are credited.
observation_status: No physical measurements are supplied; empirical applicability of the calibrated geometric dictionary remains an open obligation.

evidence_distinctions.analytic_proof: Written argument from explicitly stated assumptions; may include existence or integration steps beyond computer-checked algebra.
evidence_distinctions.lean_certificate: Kernel-checked theorem with its actual hypotheses and reported logical axioms; not blanket formalization of the manuscript.
evidence_distinctions.exact_symbolic_check: Computer-algebra identity for the stated expressions and domains; distinct from a Lean proof.
evidence_distinctions.numerical_check: Finite computation with declared domain, resolution and tolerances; not an identity, global theorem or observation.
evidence_distinctions.source_reported: Preserved historical receipts are provenance; current executed receipts live in evidence/.
evidence_distinctions.independent_review: Separately tasked AI-assisted review and calculations; not external peer review.

claims.statement: Full first-variation stationarity of the positive Milne-polar calibration is equivalent to F=a rho+b, U=a/(2rho), W=a rho, V=0 and constant odd coupling k; positive nondegenerate shape energy implies a>0.
assumptions: Oriented two-dimensional Lorentzian base; independent fields h, rho>0 and symmetric positive unimodular 2x2 M.
Local base-diffeomorphism and constant target SL(2,R) congruence invariance; derivative-polynomial action of total derivative order at most two; no extra fields.
F is C2 and U,W,V,k are C1 on the connected positive area domain.
Vary all fields independently before evaluating h=-dt^2+dr^2, rho=tr, M=diag(t/r,r/t) for every t,r>0; use compactly supported smooth variations.
The literal quotient frame and orbit normalization are fixed; a>0 additionally assumes positive nondegenerate radiative shape energy.

proof_status.analytic: proved conditional equivalence, including invariant action classification and all-field converse
proof_status.formal: Lean certifies explicit chart-algebra/derivative implications, positivity and constant-odd consequences; the full variational derivation is not formalized

claims.execution_status: Fresh symbolic suite and clean Lean build passed.
limits: Stationarity is not a positive second variation or global dynamical stability.
Overall a and bulk-inert b,k are not fixed numerically.
No uniqueness claim outside the specified derivative order, field content and frame.

claims.statement: The selected bulk action equals the orbit-volume-normalized Einstein-Hilbert action up to the explicit divergence and constant-curvature/odd boundary contributions.
assumptions: g=h_ab dx^a dx^b+rho M_IJ dy^I dy^J with no mixed blocks, two commuting spacelike symmetry directions and y-independent fields.
h is the literal quotient metric, rho>0 and det M=1; fixed orbit-coordinate normalization.
For equivalence to all vacuum equations, a is nonzero and all h,rho,M variations are retained.

proof_status.analytic: proved off shell; direct variation spans all nontrivial block equations
proof_status.formal: not a complete Lean formalization of four-dimensional differential geometry

claims.execution_status: Fresh exact symbolic off-shell curvature and mixed-Ricci checks passed.

The block ansatz restricts the gravitational sector.

claims.statement: Centered canonical uncertainty saturation selects one Gaussian ray for each positive unimodular covariance shape; the calibrated equivariant orbit-shape map is the identity.
assumptions: One canonical pair in the dimensionless Schrodinger representation on L2(R), [Q,P]=i, with calibrated dimensional scales q_star p_star=hbar.
Positive trace-one state with centered finite second moments and covariance determinant exactly 1/4.
Covariance and gravitational orbit shapes transform in the same specified SL(2,R) congruence representation; normalized orbit shape is positive unimodular.

proof_status.analytic: Gaussian-kernel reconstruction and equivariant uniqueness proved

claims.execution_status: Original covariance/witness symbolic checks and independent oscillator negative-control integrals passed.
limits: Kinematic model correspondence; it does not derive spacetime dimension, Lorentzian signature, quantized gravity or empirical applicability.
Vacuum and first excited state share normalized covariance shape but are orthogonal; saturation is essential.

assumptions: Centered saturated one-mode Gaussian family, u real and v>0.
QGT_ij=<partial_i psi|partial_j psi>-<partial_i psi|psi><psi|partial_j psi>; coordinate order (u,v).
Pure-state QFI convention g_QFI=4 Re(QGT).
claims.execution_status: Independent exact Gaussian-moment, tensor and matrix-metric identities passed.
limits: Normalization factors belong to the stated conventions.
This is a state-family metric, not the Lorentzian spacetime metric.

Smooth shape map from an oriented base patch, constant k and the induced boundary orientation.

claims.statement: Five raw metric residuals bounded by epsilon imply |V|<=2epsilon, |rho F_second|<=8epsilon/15, |W/rho-F_prime|<=25epsilon/17 and |2rho U-F_prime|<=31epsilon/15.
assumptions: rho>0 and epsilon>=0; residuals are the unscaled Euler components in the fixed dimensionless calibration.
e1=Ett(A),e2=Err(A),e3=Ett(B),e4=Err(B),e5=Etr(A)=Etr(B), where A=(2sqrt(rho),sqrt(rho)/2) and B has swapped coordinates.
All five absolute residuals are at most epsilon; genuine derivatives are required when interpreting F_prime,F_second as derivatives of an action coefficient.

proof_status.analytic: four exact inversions and triangle-inequality bounds proved; constants individually sharp for the pointwise algebraic inference problem
proof_status.formal: 8 added Lean theorems certify 4 inversions and 4 scaled inequalities in ResidualInversion; part of the 48-theorem, 8-module build

claims.execution_status: Clean Lean build passed; exact symbolic inversion and feasible sharpness witnesses passed.

claims.statement: Uniform residual control on a connected positive interval bounds all coefficients against one common affine family with explicit logarithmic errors.
assumptions: F is C2 on a connected I subset (0,infinity); the five-residual envelope epsilon>=0 holds at every rho in I.
Choose rho0 in I, a=F_prime(rho0), b=F(rho0)-a rho0.
L=abs(log(rho/rho0)); H=rho log(rho/rho0)-rho+rho0.

proof_status.analytic: proved by integrating the F_second bound and Taylor integral remainder
proof_status.formal: integrated logarithmic bounds not formalized in Lean

claims.execution_status: Exact second derivative and basepoint identities of H passed; integration proof is written explicitly.

Fixed nonzero epsilon gives no uniform near-axis bound.

claims.statement: A universal regular nontrivial scalar-current Lax family exists locally exactly when W is harmonic; its curvature is (MC-s E)/(1-s^2).
assumptions: Two-dimensional Lorentzian conformal patch; W is positive C2; M is smooth positive symmetric unimodular.
Torsion-free weighted-current system; L_plus=J_plus/(1-s), L_minus=J_minus/(1+s).
Spectral construction depends on W and the constant spectral parameter, not on specially chosen current solutions.
Generic admissible current jets with independent J_plus,J_minus and their commutator; regular s excludes 0,+1,-1.
Local simply connected subpatch for harmonic conjugate and spectral construction; avoid branch points.

proof_status.analytic: necessity and constructive sufficiency proved within the specified ansatz
proof_status.formal: Lean certifies spectral derivatives, obstruction and scalar/matrix curvature identities, not every PDE existence argument

claims.execution_status: Fresh exact symbolic suite and 256 deterministic noncommuting rational current jets passed; Lean certificates compiled.
limits: Not a classification of every possible Lax ansatz.
Constant-current solutions and s=0 do not test the stated necessity.

For every area value there is a point with that rho and rho_plus*rho_minus nonzero.
For zero intercept, the area interval approaches zero and lim(rho downarrow 0) W(rho)=0; positivity and nontriviality for c>0.

proof_status.formal: explicit affine, axis and positivity implications compiled
